legal.rulesIntro: Hang Out is about meeting real people safely. By joining, you agree to our community rules:

rules.respect: Be respectful. Harassment, hate speech, bullying or threats are not tolerated.
rules.content: No sexual, violent, illegal or otherwise objectionable content in activities, chats, photos or your profile.
rules.honest: Be yourself. No fake profiles, spam, scams or advertising.
rules.safety: Meet in public places and tell someone where you are going.

legal.enforcement: We have zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users. Use Report and Block anywhere in the app. We review reports within 24 hours and remove offending content and users.
legal.agreeCheckbox: I am 18 or older and I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the community rules above.
legal.saveFailed: Couldn't save your agreement. Check your connection and try again.
legal.contactBody: Questions, safety concerns or data requests? Email us and we will get back to you.
